messages.subject: Readland.tps error
parts:
Hi everyone,

After updating R (to 3.5.0) and RStudio (to 1.1.447), I now get the following error message when I'm trying to read in landmark data:

data<-readland.tps("dataFiles/data.tps", specID = "imageID")
Error in if (p > plm) { : argument is of length zero

Does anyone know what might cause this?

Thanks
Iris

messages.subject: Re: Readland.tps error
parts:
I thought it might be useful to attach the session info. I've uninstalled and reinstalled base R, RStudio, even XQuartz, but am still getting the same error. No one else experiencing any issues? I tried to go back to R 3.4.4 but got an error message that geomorph is not available for that version, so I'm a bit stuck now.

Cheers
Iris

messages.author: cbd06ad3fdde7090
messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] Re: Readland.tps error
parts:
Hi Dean

Well, that’s embarrassing. I hadn’t occurred to me that something might be wrong with the data file - I haven’t made any changes to it and it was loading until now. It’s 2D landmark data from faces that were digitised using Webmorph, and then converted to .tps format. Reading your email, I had a look at the file and noticed that the number of landmarks for each specimen was specified as “lm=“ when it should be “LM=“. Editing the file accordingly has resolved the issue!

Thanks!
Iris
